role: Distance and duration formatters for the Coach Report email; formatDistance is also used by WorkoutRecoveryService.

units.does: Formats metres as '%.2f mi' (imperial) or '%.2f km' in the app locale; '—' when nil or ≤0.

branches.effect: miles; else km (.auto is treated as metric — callers pass a resolved preference)

flags.text: UnitsPreference.formatDistance(meters:) already formats metres as mi/km for a preference (resolving .auto and using locale-aware Measurement formatting); this re-implements it with a fixed '%.2f km'/'%.2f mi' and treats .auto as metric.

units.does: Formats seconds as 'h:mm:ss' when ≥1 h, else 'm:ss' (not localized digits).

flags.text: Identical h:mm:ss / m:ss formatting to WorkoutStatsCards.formatDuration(sec:); GPXExporter.durationLabel and TCXExporter.humanSummary durLabel do the m:ss form without hours.
